route_selection.rule: Lowest whole-trip fuel cost + driving hours x $50/hour + $5/stop among feasible routes.
route_selection.reason: Alternative saves $16.85 in total operating cost: $16.81 less fuel cost, $4.96 extra driving cost (6 minutes), and $5.00 less stop cost.

vehicle.assumption: Fuel is bought only at stations on the route; the vehicle arrives with as little fuel as possible.
